_doc: Data inputs for `lexeme-aligner align-text`, fetched by `lexeme-aligner fetch-inputs` into one data folder (see fetch_inputs.py). A pinned sha256 is checked on every download; moving a pin is a deliberate edit here (and a PROVENANCE line). Licences are those of the data, not of this code (GPL-3.0-or-later).

files.name: spine
files.licence: CC BY 4.0 (MACULA Hebrew and Greek, Clear Bible; built by bcv-query)
files._note: bcv-query's immutable release lexeme-spine-macula-2026-10-12 (bcv-commons/spine-releases; built by bcv-query 79b79ad): the spine our published data was built with (f1003a2b..., spine_content_sha256 471a3ac7...). Newer releases (2026-10-27: + greek/greekstrong columns) are accepted by `content` when this pin is moved to them; a build that changes a row of these columns is refused.

content._doc: tables-v1: sha256 over these tables/columns, rows in `order`, one compact JSON row per line (fetch_inputs.content_sha256). Columns = all of spine_words in our pinned f1003a2b... (the chain reads whatever columns exist; this pins every one it can read).
